The Chinese characters for Ivy

As a transliteration, Ivy is usually written 艾薇 (Ài wēi). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

艾
Ài
mugwort, artemisia
薇
wēi
a fern, rose (in names)

Origin and meaning

The name Ivy has English roots and means “the ivy plant”.

About the name Ivy

A nature name from the climbing ivy plant, now a top US pick.
